requests.name: List notifications (paged) + unread count
requests.testScript:
pw.test("200", () => pw.expect(pw.response.status).toBe(200));
const n = pw.response.body.data.notifications; if (n && n[0]) pw.env.set('notificationId', n[0].id);

requests.name: Unread count (badge)
requests.description:
Just the unread count, for the bell badge.

### Expected (200)
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Unread count fetched.", "data": { "count": 2 } }
```

requests.name: Mark one read
requests.description:
Marks one notification read (only if it belongs to the caller). Returns the new `unreadCount`. Also pushes an updated `notification:unread_count` over socket.

### Expected (200)
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Notification marked read.", "data": { "unreadCount": 1 } }
```

requests.name: Mark all read
requests.description:
Marks ALL of the caller's unread notifications read. Returns how many were updated.

### Expected (200)
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "All notifications marked read.", "data": { "updated": 2, "unreadCount": 0 } }
```
